::: {#def-binary}
#### Binary random variable

A **binary variable** is a [random variable](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/random-variables.html#def-random-variable) $X$
that has only two possible values in its [range](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/random-variables.html#def-range).
The two values are usually coded as $0$ and $1$,
so that $\rangef{X} = \{0, 1\}$.
:::
